project-ai-activity-clear.v1.description: Clears unlinked metadata for one authenticated account and installation; it never mutates projects.

project-ai-activity-history.v1.title: Evidrilo per-installation Project AI activity history v1
project-ai-activity-history.v1.description: Metadata only. General entries are unlinked. Prompt and response transcripts are not included or retained by this contract.

project-ai-general-chat-request.v2.title: Evidrilo isolated Project AI General chat request v2
project-ai-general-chat-request.v2.description: Standalone message only. Project identifiers, project context, and caller-supplied history are not accepted.

project-ai-general-chat-result.v2.title: Evidrilo isolated Project AI General chat result v2
project-ai-general-chat-result.v2.description: Structured answer and token-priced credit cost. The message and answer are not part of activity history.

project-ai-scaffold-request.v1.title: Evidrilo project AI scaffold request v1

project-ai-scaffold-settlement-request.v.title: Evidrilo project AI scaffold settlement request v1
project-ai-scaffold-settlement-request.v.description: POST this body to /v1/project-ai/scaffold/settlement. The Idempotency-Key header must equal requestId from the preview; reuse it unchanged for identical retries.

project-ai-scaffold-settlement.v1.title: Evidrilo project AI scaffold settlement response v1

project-ai-scaffold.v1.title: Evidrilo project AI scaffold preview response v1
project-ai-scaffold.v1.description: A successful preview reports the credits charged from validated token usage. The server reserves the maximum possible request cost before provider dispatch and settles the actual cost after generation, regardless of whether the student later applies or dismisses the preview. The local project ID and revision are echoed for stale-context rejection; local project content is not persisted by this endpoint.

project-ai-stage-assist-request.v1.title: Evidrilo stage-bound Project AI request v1
project-ai-stage-assist-request.v1.description: A project request binds one authenticated account, one installation, one owned project, one published template stage, and only student-selected allowlisted fields. GENERAL is accepted as a choice but remains unavailable until its cost, limit, and retention policy is approved.

project-ai-stage-assist-settlement-reque.title: Evidrilo stage-assist settlement request v1
project-ai-stage-assist-settlement-reque.description: The Idempotency-Key header must match requestId from the preview. Reuse the identical body and key for retries. Applied or edited outcomes must name the resulting server project revision.

project-ai-stage-assist.v1.title: Evidrilo stage-bound Project AI preview response v1
project-ai-stage-assist.v1.description: A non-mutating, typed proposal bound to one server-owned project revision and one declared template operation. References are limited to the student's selected project evidence. The client must review and apply through its project workflow.
